[[File:Bailey.png|thumb|250px|Bailey]] '''Bailey''' (Japanese: '''ヒカル''' ''Hikaru'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP122|Flower Power]]''. She travels around in her van, where she {{pkmn|training|trains}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} to dance and perform various acrobatic moves to put on shows, similar to a [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met Bailey at the [[Florando]] [[Pokémon Exhibition]]. She later helped teach {{AP|Pikachu}} several dance-like dodging techniques to assist in his upcoming {{pkmn|battle}}s. One of her {{p|Bellossom}} lacked the confidence to do a complex flip move until a fight with {{TRT}} inspired it to finally execute it perfectly. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bailey |pkmn=Bellossom (×2) |nick=Belle and Bella |type1=Grass |img=Belle and Bella.png |epnum=EP122 |epname=Flower Power |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |vaennote=both |desc=Bailey has two {{p|Bellossom}} named '''Belle''' (Japanese: '''レイ''' ''Rei'') and '''Bella''' (Japanese: '''ハナ''' ''Hana'') who she uses to perform acrobatic dances. They first appeared training with Bailey in preparation for the upcoming [[Florando]] [[Pokémon Exhibition]], attracting a huge audience including {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Bailey told them to do a "Bell-oop-de-loop", but something went wrong and Bella came crashing down on Ash. It was then revealed that the Bellossom used to be able to perform the trick, but Bella was in a bit of a slump and couldn't quite get the hang of the "Bell-oop-de-loop", making it sad. Then, in a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{TRT}}, they were able to perform their moves to dodge {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Victreebel}} and put them to {{status|sleep}} with Sleep Powder. Later, they helped teach {{AP|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Misty|Togepi}} dance moves. It was then revealed that Belle and Bella used to battle, but preferred to dance. Later, they were captured along with other performer's Pokémon by Team Rocket, but Pikachu was able to get them back down to the ground. After Belle and Bella were free, they performed a successful "Bell-oop-de-loop" and sent Team Rocket blasting off with 'Tornado Twister'. At the Pokémon Exhibition, Belle and Bella performed another successful "Bell-oop-de-loop" and got a standing ovation. Belle and Bella's only known move is {{m|Sleep Powder}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color light}}|bordercolor={{grass color}} |ja=鈴木真仁 ''Masami Suzuki'' |en=[[List of English voice actors|Emily Niebo]] |ar=إيمان بيطار ''Iman Bitar'' |fi=Elise Langenoja |it=Elisabetta Spinelli (Mediaset dub)
